title: pref/case payload
description: UPSERT payload of pref/case: the look of the account's display case, whole, the same on every device it signs in on. Last writer wins, and the whole look is one value: two devices' looks are never merged field by field. A DELETE with an empty payload goes back to the app's default look. The ids (pattern, wall, arrange) are the app's own; a reader that does not know one shows its default for that field and keeps the facet. Serialized, at most 485 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

pattern.description: The id of the cabinets that line the wall, e.g. ikea-klingsbo, or several joined by +: 1 to 128 lowercase letters, digits, - and +.

ceiling_tenths_mm.description: The room's ceiling height in tenths of a millimetre (24384 is 8 ft), 1 to 100,000.

clearance_tenths_mm.description: The room every compartment keeps above a figure, in tenths of a millimetre (254 is 1 in), 0 to 10,000. A reader clamps it to what it supports.

wall.description: The id of the wall's colour, e.g. cream, or custom for wall_custom: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and -.

wall_custom.description: The custom wall colour, #rrggbb in lowercase hex. Always carried, and used while wall is custom.

arrange.description: The id of the order the case stands its figures in, e.g. series-scale-name: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and -.

show_estimated.description: Whether figures whose height or width is an estimate are outlined.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
